function norm(s){return String(s||'').toLowerCase().replace(/\b(dr|doctor|prof|professor)\.?\b/g,' ').replace(/[^a-z0-9\u0600-\u06ff]+/g,' ').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ');}
const q=$('LA Extract').first().json;if(!q.phone)return [{json:{status:'invalid_input',appointments:[],result:q.lang==='en'?'I need the phone number used for the booking.':'Booking wala phone number chahiye.'}}];const now=Date.now();let rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json).filter(r=>String(r.phone||'')===q.phone&&!['cancelled','canceled'].includes(String(r.status||'').toLowerCase()));if(q.date)rows=rows.filter(r=>String(r.date||'')===q.date);if(q.doctor_name){const n=norm(q.doctor_name);rows=rows.filter(r=>norm(r.doctor_name).includes(n)||n.includes(norm(r.doctor_name)));}rows=rows.filter(r=>{const t=new Date(String(r.date||'')+'T'+String(r.time||'00:00')+':00+05:00').getTime();return Number.isFinite(t)&&t>=now-60*60000;}).sort((a,b)=>(String(a.date)+String(a.time)).localeCompare(String(b.date)+String(b.time))).slice(0,5);const appointments=rows.map(r=>({appointment_id:r.appointment_id,doctor_name:r.doctor_name,date:r.date,time:r.time,status:r.status}));return [{json:{status:appointments.length?'found':'not_found',appointments,result:appointments.length?(q.lang==='en'?`I found ${appointments.length} upcoming appointment(s).`:`Ji, ${appointments.length} upcoming appointment mili hain.`):(q.lang==='en'?'I could not find an active upcoming appointment on that number.':'Is number par koi active upcoming appointment nahi mili.')}}];

parameters.content:
> GitHub portable build: Google Sheet ID is read from `$env.CLINIC_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`. Reconnect Google Sheets and Google Calendar OAuth credentials after import.

# FINAL SETUP — GOOGLE SHEETS

This workflow reuses the Google Sheet + Google Calendar credentials from your original **Book Slot.json**.

Create these exact tabs/columns:

## Clinic Config
clinic_name | address | phone | working_hours | open_time | close_time | timezone | closed_days | holidays | minimum_notice_minutes | default_slot_minutes

Examples:
closed_days = friday,sunday
holidays = 2026-12-25,2027-01-01
minimum_notice_minutes = 15
default_slot_minutes = 10

## Doctors
doctor_id | doctor_name | aliases | specialization | sub_specialization | qualification | gender | fee | branch | calendar_id | slot_minutes | off_dates | status

Example:
D001 | Dr Ahmed Ali | Ahmed,Dr Ahmed | Cardiology | Interventional Cardiology | MBBS,FCPS | Male | 3000 | Main | doctor-calendar-id@group.calendar.google.com | 10 | 2026-09-20,2026-09-21 | active

**Use one Google Calendar per doctor.** This prevents Dr Ahmed's 6:00 PM appointment from blocking Dr Sara's 6:00 PM appointment.

## Doctor Schedules
doctor_id | day | start_time | end_time | slot_minutes | active

Use multiple rows for split shifts. Example Monday 10:00-13:00 and Monday 17:00-21:00.

## Appointments
appointment_id | calendar_event_id | doctor_id | doctor_name | patient_name | phone | date | time | slot_minutes | status | reason | language | created_at | updated_at | reminder_sent

## FAQ
topic | keywords | answer_en | answer_ur

## Callbacks
callback_id | name | phone | reason | requested_at | status

## Call Logs
call_id | phone | started_at | ended_at | duration_sec | transcript | recording_url | outcome | summary

# FINAL VAPI TOOL MAP

Use Vapi **Function Tools**. Each server URL is your n8n PRODUCTION URL:

search_doctors          -> /webhook/search-doctors
check_availability      -> /webhook/check-availability
book_appointment        -> /webhook/book-appointment
lookup_appointment      -> /webhook/lookup-appointment
reschedule_appointment  -> /webhook/reschedule-appointment
cancel_appointment      -> /webhook/cancel-appointment
answer_question         -> /webhook/answer-question
request_callback        -> /webhook/request-callback

Optional clinic_info    -> /webhook/clinic-info

Use Vapi's built-in **endCall** tool for ending calls; do not send endCall to n8n.
Configure assistant server messages so `end-of-call-report` is POSTed to `/webhook/call-ended` for call logging.

The workflow parses current Vapi `toolCallList` / `toolWithToolCallList` payloads and also the older `toolCalls[].function.arguments` format.
All Function Tool responses are HTTP 200 and return Vapi's required `results[{toolCallId,result}]` envelope. `result` is a one-line JSON string.

# ASSISTANT PROMPT SUMMARY

Use the supplied file **Vapi_Clinic_Receptionist_FINAL_Prompt.txt** as the Vapi System Prompt.
Core rules: female receptionist; English caller -> English; Urdu/Roman-Urdu/mixed caller -> natural Pakistani Urdu; use Urdu script for Urdu words to improve TTS; never diagnose; resolve doctor/specialization before checking slots; 10-minute schedule by default; caller ID is used automatically; use structured tool results; callback on unresolved admin issues; use Vapi built-in endCall after closing.

# PRODUCTION / SCALE NOTES

1. Workflow timezone: Asia/Karachi.
2. Protect public webhooks using Vapi server credentials + n8n Header Auth before production.
3. One Google Calendar per doctor; doctor schedule is kept in Doctor Schedules.
4. Current flow re-checks the doctor's calendar immediately before creating/updating an appointment and detects idempotent retries by ToolCallId.
5. Google Calendar does NOT provide an atomic "reserve if still free" transaction. For a busy hospital / many simultaneous calls, move booking locks to PostgreSQL/Supabase or Cal.com API v2 reservations before calling this enterprise-grade.
6. Keep reason-for-visit short/admin only. Do not use this receptionist as diagnosis/medical-advice storage.
7. Decide clinic policy for Vapi recordings/transcripts; disable recording storage if not needed.
8. Reminder calls need n8n environment variables VAPI_PRIVATE_KEY, VAPI_REMINDER_ASSISTANT_ID, VAPI_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.
9. Load-test with parallel calls before rollout.
